component.name: Open NGenuity
component.summary: Control DPI and polling rate on a HyperX Pulsefire Haste 2 Core Wireless

description.p: HyperX NGENUITY is Windows-only. Open NGenuity is a small Linux app that talks to the Pulsefire Haste 2 Core Wireless 2.4 GHz dongle through the existing ngenuity CLI and lets you change DPI stages and polling rate.
Bluetooth mode cannot be configured. Install the bundled udev rule on the host so the app can open the vendor HID interface without root.
